chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, for Allah is a Garden which none shall enter except for three; one of them being the one who judges regarding himself with the truth.
ai.seo_question: Who are the three people who will enter Paradise according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), linking the divine promise of Paradise to the internal discipline of self-accountability (muhasabah). This hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on justice beginning with the self, where one’s internal verdict aligns with divine truth before extending to external dealings. It serves as a foundational principle for spiritual purification, suggesting that true entry into Paradise requires mastering one’s own ego through rigorous self-judgment.
